balls.text: Tewatia puts it away and GT finish on 217 for 6! Sandeep goes for the yorker on off and middle, he gets down on a knee and sweeps it through backward square leg to take 16 off the final over
Goes for the wide yorker, he charges down and takes it on the full, drives it to mid-off and does not take the run
Another bumper, passes way over the batter's head. Wide called, this over stretches more
Digs it in, he charges down and swings but misses
Trademark Tewatia shot! That made superb sound and it has gone the distance. Full and angling away, he gets down on a knee and slogs it over deep midwicket. 11 off 3 balls this over already
Sprays it wide after spotting him charge down, he leaves it be and called wide
Very full and just outside off, Tewatia is in a tangle and misses
Lofted over mid-off. That is overpitched outside off from around the stumps, enough time for Tewatia to get under it

WHAT A CATCH! Jaiswal, you beauty! Superbly done. Back of a length slower one outside off, 113.7kph, Rashid walks across the line, waits and looks to swipe it across with his front leg in the air. Jaiswal reacts quickly at square leg - runs to his right, dives full length and hangs on. End of the mini blitz from Rashid
Yorker outside off, squeezed to deep third. Rashid is quick and comes charging back for the second, since it has gone to the longer side, 200 up for GT
Full and wide, he leaves it be
No-look shot, Rashid version! Almost goes the distance. Bumper on off, he takes his eyes off and swings his bat like a periscope, gets a thick edge over short fine leg
Rashid Khan announces his arrival with a mighty blow! Such a free swing of the blade after charging down the track to a length ball. Makes room and crashed it over long-on
Short and wide outside off, he thinks of the ramp but lets it be, wide called

Thin edge and gone, nice catch from Samson, Sai Sudharsan walks. Full and swinging in towards off, he clears his front leg to go downtown but gets an inside edge. Samson has to dive to his right, after moving to his left because of the initial angle. Set batter dismissed for GT
Digs it into the surface, the slower one at 117.7kph, he misses the pull

Dropped! Dubey waited to time the jump but couldn't hang on. Another slower bouncer on middle and leg, Sai Sudharsan went back, waited a second and pulled it, almost straight to deep backward square leg. Archer cannot believe what he has seen, 11 runs and a wicket off his final over
Short and angling in, pulled through backward square leg
Back of a length again outside off, he sways away and leaves it be, 149kph
In the air... short of fine leg running in. Slower bouncer down leg, 118.6kph, he went for the pull but top-edged it
Yorker on off, dug out to backward point for a quick one
Angling down leg on a length, he misses the flick

Lucky, lucky Tewatia! Full toss dipping in on off, 138.2kph, he is unsure of the trajectory and goes for the heave but takes his eye off it. The ball goes off the top edge and flies over the keeper for half a dozen
Back of a length on middle, pulled to long-on
Good comeback. Goes for the yorker, very full on off, he stays deep and looks to flick it away. Gets a thick inside edge past leg after brushing his back pad
Back-to-back boundaries for Sai Sudharsan. Length ball angling away again, he slaps it over cover. Two boundaries in two balls from Sandeep after going 14 balls without one
Evades the leaping man in the deep! Length ball angling away, Sai Sudharsan stands still and scythes it over deep cover-point. Jurel was briefly interested but it cleared him easily
Length ball just outside off, he taps it in front of point for a quick one

Nicked and gone! Superb stuff from Sandeep. Bowls it on a length, wide outside off and angles it away. Rutherford doesn't move his feet and reaches out to slash it away. Only manages a tickle through to Samson. Sandeep is yet to concede a boundary tonight and he is on the board

Quicker length ball around leg, he goes back to heave it across but it goes off something and evades Samson to the on side. They run, and it is given as runs off the bat! 2 for 54 for Theekshana tonight
That is HUUUUGGGEEEEEEE!. No sighters needed. It is right in the slot, full from over the wicket, Rutherford clears his front leg and sends in 10 rows into the long-on stand

Deceived, tata, goodbye! Shahrukh charges down to go big over the off side. Theekshana anticipates it and fires it full and wide. Samson is ready for it and after Shahrukh fails to reach it, gathers it and disturbs the stumps. Crucial blow this
Sprays it very wide down leg, Samson dives and parries it through square leg, a la a goalkeeper
Drilled straight down the ground, Parag does extremely well. He rushes to his left from long-off and parries it to long-on to keep it to two. It was full and he blasted it straight back
Yorker on middle, clipped to deep midwicket

Fired full down leg, Samson deflects it to short fine leg. And they steal a bye even if Sai Sudharsan has to rush! He was ambling to the other end before realising the short fine leg was having a shy at the bowler's end, Sandeep the man
Humongous, almost goes the distance! Nicely floated outside off, Sai Sudharsan takes a massive stride forward and lofts it inside out over cover. Just lands in front of the boundary cushion
Full again, he cannot get under that and drives it straight to deep cover-point. Superb over, just five off it
Yorker outside off, steered straight to backward point
Slower one outside off, plunked down to long-on
Full and outside off, cracked away to deep cover-point
Back of a length outside off, pulled to deep midwicket
Angles it away on a length, slashed away to deep backward point

Is Shahrukh bowled? Or stumped? Theekshana is unsure. Samson is unsure. The TV umpire is called in for a stumping appeal, an accidental one that. Theekshana tossed it up, Shahrukh went for the drive but was beaten on the inside because of the drip. The ball hit Samson's gloves and disturbed the stumps, but Shahrukh's back leg was in. Huge cheers in Ahmedabad
This is deliberate. And smart! Full and wide outside off, he reaches forward and slices it away from backward point. Once it clears the in-field, there is no protection in the deep behind square
Edged and in the gap. Tossed up fuller and wider outside off, Shahrukh goes hard at it away from the body and gets it between short third and backward point. It was pushed quicker at 107.6kph
Walloped! Don't bowl half-trackers to Shahrukh, of all. He quickly goes back and pulls it onto the deep midwicket stands. It was the carrom ball
Around the wicket, wider outside off on a length, 96.6kph, slapped to long-off
Flatter and on a length on leg, clipped through midwicket
Once again a low full toss wide outside off, he walks into it and toe-ends the drive to extra cover
Goes for the yorker, swings away, SRK makes no contact. Called wide. Deshpande and Samson not happy, the former asks his captain for a review but RR don't

Powered away in fine fashion. This is what Shahrukh can do. Full and outside off, it is in the slot and he frees his arms to send it sailing over deep extra cover. It is the longer side but does not matter to SRK
Bangs it short and it passes well over the head
Yorker outside off, Shahrukh can only toe-end it back to the bowler
Spears in a rocket on the pad, flicked through backward square leg
Charges down at the length ball to go over the off side but misses it completely
Oh, what a shot! Offcutter on a short length, 124.8kph, Sai Sudharsan hops and slashes it over backward point, well away from deep third
Full and outside off, he leans forward and drives it to deep cover
Short and angling away outside off, he hops and looks for the ramp, but gets a thick edge to deep third
Another back of a length ball, nipping away outside off, 122.1kph, he fails to make contact on the heave
Back of a length, slower one, 119.3kph, Shahrukh is again early into his swish across the line. Looks like he has a memo - of going really hard at everything
Clipped away in style. Length ball on the pad, 118.2kph, Shahrukh has enough time to get it away from short fine leg
Inside edge! Fortune favours Shahrukh on this occasion. Length ball angling away from him, SRK looks to have a heave-ho across the line and gets it just past off stump
Back of a length angling away, Sai Sudharsan stands tall and pulls it through midwicket. Timing is good but the man in the deep slides and keeps it to two, 100 up for RR
Back of a length slanting away, around off, 148.2kph, Sai Sudharsan arches back for the ramp but only makes contact with thin air
Banged in short, angling down leg, Shahrukh goes for the swivel and pull but misses. Samson has to leap to keep it down
Back of a length slower one outside off, Archer likes it. SRK swings across the line and misses it, 113.7kph. Way too early, the bowler has a giggle
Leading edge</strong? over cover as he looks to turn a full length ball through the on side. That gets him two to get going
Direct hit would have been curtains! Full outside off, he powers it straight to mid-off and takes off. Sandeep misses his shy at the bowler's end. There was never a run there actually

a confident and an animate appeal for lbw, but turned down! That looked like heading down the leg side... but Samson reviews! The first replay shows the ball going below the bat, as Buttler looked to pull but missed. The ball was on a short of a length, and there's no bat involved as Buttler is beaten. The ball pitched short on off, and turned back in considerably. And, and... ball tracking shows the ball would have hit leg stump as Buttler was hit on the back pad! Samson's call works for RR, who break a threatening stand
a full toss angling into middle and off, and driven back on the bounce to Theekshana's left
fifty for Sudharsan! His excellent form continues, as he clips this good-length ball on the stumps towards midwicket
wide of long-on, and four! That went right in the gap between the fielders at long-on and a straightish deep midwicket, as Sudharsan slog swept this full ball outside off
bowls this full and straight, and it is driven back to Theekshana
short of a length on middle and off, and shapes to turn in. Punched to long-on

beautiful bowling! Deshpande angles it across at 137kph, and lands it on a yorker length on off. Sudharsan looks to jam his bat down, but is beaten. The ball, meanwhile, shapes away to finish just outside off
a low and dipping full toss arrives just outside off, and is nudged to deep midwicket
short of a length on middle, and it is clipped to deep midwicket
slow and short, and wide! He bowls this too short at middle, and the ball shapes away to finish wide of off as Sudharsan let it go
change of pace from Deshpande, who goes full and just outside off. Flicked by Buttler to deep-backward square leg
on the fuller side of a length on off, and he leans into a push wide of long-on. Two runs hurriedly taken by the batters
short of a length on middle, and pulled to deep midwicket by Sudharsan

bashed over the bowler's head! Theekshana even raised his hands trying to anticipate the ball, but this one was hit hard. It was bowled slower, though, and full and outside off. Buttler waited for it to come, before launching it back forcefully
fuller and just outside off. Punched towards deep cover for two
slapped wide of long-off! That never seemed like heading for the boundary, though. But it was timed really well, as he went back at this length ball just outside off
angles this in, and goes on a length on the stumps. Sudharsan pulls to deep midwicket
short and around sixth stump at Buttler, who shifts his weight back, and chops it towards point
on a length on middle, and slower this time. Punched to deep cover
starts with a wide! Bowls it on the shorter side, and outside leg. Sudharsan looked to swipe but misses

misfield at fine leg! As a result, it is four more for Buttler! Deshpande was at the boundary, and let the ball slide below him as he ran and slid to his right himself. Another slower ball from Farooqi, but this is short and just outside off, and bouncing at a comfortable height for Buttler to pull powerfully

the man at short fine leg thought he had a chance... but gave up in the end! Slower delivery from Farooqi, who angled it across and went on a fullish length just outside off. Buttler got across early, and scooped it between the keeper and the short-fine-leg fileder
beaten! Short in length on middle and leg, and the ball shapes away to finish outside off. Buttler looked to pull but was completely beaten. Looked like he swung his bat early
on the shorter side of a length on off, and Sudharsan clips it to deep-backward square leg
good running! Buttler got a full delivery angling across and pitching around middle and off, and he pushed it towards mid-off before calling for the run
shortish delivery pitching on off, and finishing around middle. Pulled almost half-heartedly towards deep square leg
a third slower ball at Sudharsan, although this one is full and straight. Driven to long-on to keep ticking
another one at only 105kph to Sudharsan, as Sandeep bowls on the shorter side of a length on leg. Sudharsan clips it late, and behind square, for two
Sandeep sees Buttler coming, and launches a yorker bang on the stumps! Buttler eventually ends up squatting and dragging it to long-on
bowls a slower ball while angling it in, and going close to the stumps. It pitches on a good length on the stumps, and is punched down long-on
this time Buttler backs away, and Sandeep bowls on the shorter side of a length outside leg. Clipped to deep-backward square leg
bouncer to Buttler, and called wide! Sandeep pitches it short on middle and off, and the ball takes off to end way above Buttler's bat, as he looked to pull
on a length, and just outside off. Buttler steps out, and ends up clipping towards midwicket

slower ball, but Sudharsan is in great form! He reads the change of pace of this length delivery around sixth stump, and plays the late cut to beat the man at deep cover to his right. Great placement there
a fullish delivery slightly wide of off, and Buttler leans into the drive to mid-off's right. The fielder actually seemed wider than usual
on the shorter side of a length on off, and punched towards point for a quick single

excellent timing! Even Archer, at mid-off, gives up. Deshpande angled it across, and bowled on a good length. It pitched around seventh stump, and Sudharsan simply drove forward effortlessly to beat mid-off to his left
another wide! This is full and outside leg, as he looks to flick but misses
scooped over short fine leg! He decides to try something to get GT going, and gets across the stumps early. He spots a short-of-a-length ball arriving around sixth stump, and ends it flying for six
sharp and short, and on the stumps! Sudharsan is almost taken by surprise by the bounce, as he jumps a little before fending it down the pitch
starts with a wide. He angles this across from over the wicket, and bowls on a length outside off. The ball straightens after pitching, and ends outside leg, as Sudharsan looked to clip but missed
again Buttler looks to throw his bat at a wide-ish ball outside off, with the length being fullish. He ends up nudging it to mid-off this time
fullish ball, and swinging away to come just outside off. Tucked towards point for a single
on the shorter side of a length on off, and clipped wide of Archer at short fine leg. Two runs hurriedly taken

a late adjustment from Sudharsan, and that's six! He had initially walked down the pitch, but seeing that Farooqi bowled and nearly cramped him for room by going around leg stump, he improvised to leap and upper cut for six
this is a dipping full toss on the stumps, and around his knee. Flicked to deep square leg by closing the face of the bat

far and wide from Buttler, but he still goes flashing, and misses! Farooqi bowls it on a short of a length, and angles it across for it to end wide of off. Buttler looks to play away from himself, and can't get bat on ball
short of a length on middle and leg, and shaping away to finish around off. Dabbed to Archer's left
tickled behind square again

acres of space available on the off side, and that is four! Archer bowls the inswinger, and lands it quite full and just outside off. Buttler's front foot is only half-forward, and he drives in the huge gap to the deep-cover boundary
nearly taken at short leg! That just went to the fielder's right, as Buttler pushed forward at this short-of-a-length ball, but got an inside edge. The ball dribbled away behind square for two
wow, welcomes Buttler with a terrific bouncer! Archer bangs it short around middle and off, and Buttler has to sway out of the way hurriedly

bowled him! Looked like it was too much pace for Gill to handle! The ball hits the side of off stump at 147kph after pitching on a fullish length around fifth stump. Gill was driving far away from his body, thus leaving a huge gap between bat and pad. The ball shaped back in, and clattered the off stump, even as Gill's bat seemed to have come down late for that shot. Early blow for GT!

lovely bowling! It is angled in, and lands on a length on off while swinging in. Suddenly, though, the ball jags away to finish around fifth stump, with Sudharsan having a poke, but getting beaten on the outside edge
fuller length than the previous ball, and the line is this time is around off. Sudharsan taps it towards deep point, where there's a fielder this time, and they pinch two

punched to deep-backward point! He opens the face of the bat slightly, and does so late, as Farooqi goes on the shorter side of a length, and wide of off. The ball shapes away after pitching, and Sudharsan beats the man at point to his left
sharp inswing for Farooqi! This ball is quite full, and finishes around middle and off, as Sudharsan ends up driving to mid-on
this swings in, and lands on a good length around middle and off. Tucked towards the man placed close in at midwicket
angles it across, and goes on the shorter side of a length around middle and leg. Gill pushes at it by making room, and gets an inside edge on to his pad

top edge, and four over the wicketkeeper's head! Archer touches 152kph, and decides to go short again. This one, though, pitches on middle, and sails over to end close to Sudharsan's head. The latter goes for the pull, and luckily, manages to get four despite not being in control

Archer appeals for lbw, but the umpire isn't convinced. Samson and co ponder a review, but don't go for it eventually. Replays show the ball was shortish, and pitching just outside leg, as Sudharsan looked to clip but was hit on his pads
back of a length again around off, and nudged towards midwicket to get off the mark
wide ball, but he has Gill on his toes! Bangs it on a back of a length on off, and gets it to finish outside leg, with Gill half-ducking at it
shorter side of a length on middle and off at 144kph, and dabbed towards point for a hurried single
some extra bounce this time! Archer hits a short length at 139kph on middle and off, and again the ball moves away to end up wide-ish of off. Sudharsan was slashing at it, but was beaten again
beaten first ball! Archer bangs it on a back of a length around middle, and gets it shape away to finish in the corridor outside off. Sudharsan has a jab, but misses the ball

All over! Gujarat Titans continue their winning run with a massive 58-run win. Tossed up nicely around leg, he charges down to go big and hits it straight to long-off, where Sai Sudharsan dives forward to take it inches above the turf. Can there be a better way for him to end the match?
Slower through the air on a length on off, he clears his front leg and mistimes his slog through mid-on
Backs away to the length ball and pushes it through mid-on
Slower one full on leg, clipped through square leg, 105.1kph
Full and straight on middle, 141.1kph, he makes room and hits it straight to mid-off
Short ball just outside off, he goes back to pull but does not connect
Yorker on leg, flicked to short midwicket
Full and outside off, drives it to mid-off and runs with the shot
Full and sliding down leg, he misses the click
Short and wide outside off, he looks to ramp it over the keeper and slip but misses. Just two off Prasidh's final over of the night
Back of a length angling in on middle and leg, he fails to clip it away and wears it on the body
Length ball outside off, he fishes at it and is beaten, 142kph
Full on off, driven to mid-off
Yorker on off, squeezed out to the on side. Prasidh briefly rushes towards it but leaves it seeing it go to mid-on. They take a quick run
back of a length outside off, he backs away and steers it to deep third
Inside edge past off! Tossed up outside off, it is the carrom ball. Sandeep goes hard at it and gets away
All height, no distance! Lands it on a length on middle, Deshpande slogs it high and straight to Rashid at deep midwicket. RR's net run rate will take a hit here
Fuller on off, nudged to cover
Fuller on leg, clipped through backward square leg
Fuller and wider outside off, pushed through cover
Quicker one just outside off, patted in front of cover-point

That's the end of Hetmyer! RR's hopes plummet. All over for them! Bumper down leg, Hetmyer swivels and pulls. It bounces more for him and he gets more height than distance. Sai Kishore at deep backward square leg takes it calmly. Hettie is disappointed and it shows - he hits his helmet with his gloves and admonishes himself as he walks back
Length ball on middle and leg, he gets a thick inside back down the ground
Full and outside off, driven through cover
Soft dismissal! Back of a length on off and middle, Archer is in no position to free his hands. It gets bit on him and he plonks it towards mid-off. Easiest of catches for Gill

Another skier, will someone take it? Noooooo! Noone gets a hand to hit. Hetmyer looks to launch it out of the ground but hits it miles in the air. Gill runs back to his left from mid-off, even as Shahrukh runs forward from long-on. Noone gets a hand to it, Gill despite the dive
Crrrruunnncchhheedddd! Full and wide outside off, angling away, he clears his front leg and thrashes it through cover to bring up a 29-ball fifty
Full on middle, swipes it on the bounce to deep midwicket, 12 off SaiKi's first over
Fuller on middle and off, chips it past the non-striker
Very full on off, clipped through midwicket
Gone the dtsiance! Once again tosses it wide outside off, Hetmyer does not go against the spin this time. Hits it high over long-on with the turn
The bumper angling away, takes Hettie by surprise and he leaves it be
Skied high... and dropped! Hetmyer given a life. Sai Kishore drags him wide by sliding it across, he slices it high over the off side. Arshad rushes in from sweeper cover, dives and shells it
Flatter and wider outside off to start, he misses the cut. Given as wide
Full and wide outside off, cracked away through extra cover. Shahrukh runs to his left from long-off, dives and keeps it to two. Rashid is done for tonight
Shortish on the stumps, heaved away to deep midwicket
Despatched! Length ball on leg, spinning down, Hetmyer gets down on a knee and swipes it over backward square leg. Sai Kishore runs to his left and slides but is unable to prevent the boundary
Spinning away form a length, punched through point

This looks close! Rashid knows it, Buttler knows it and the umpire agrees. But Dubey opts to review. He looks to flick the length ball on middle across the line, misses it completely. Three reds on ball-tracking and Dubey takes a review with him
Huge appeal for lbw but GT don't review. Dubey is back in the crease and looks to turn it across but misses. Perhaps an inside edge, which is what Gill indicates
Back of a length on middle, pulled to short midwicket, successful comeback from PK
Length ball on middle and leg, clipped through midwicket for two
Lands it in line of the stumps, pushed back to the bowler
Angling away on a length, punched to deep cover

Edged and gone! Prasidh gets the extra bounce on the surface to work for him Back of a length just outside off at 139.1kph, Samson hops and looks to steer it past short third, like he did against Khejroliya an over again. But this one gets quicker at him and bounces more. As a result, it goes off the edge straight to Sai Kishore in the circle at short third. Massive blow for RR
Length ball on leg, he hops and tucks it through square leg
Quicker one on a length on leg, clipped through square leg, 14 off the over
Quicker and down leg, he plays inside the line, good take from Buttler
Flatter and quicker down leg, he misses the flick. There was a sound but the keeper did not collect, perhaps off the leg
Strays in line, pays the price. Over-correction after the previous ball. This is speared at 95.5kph, down leg on a shortish length. Hetmyer gets down on a knee and pulls it over short fine leg
Fetch that! Tossed up just outside off, 84.5kph, it is the wrong'un but it doesn't matter. Right in Hetmyer's arc as he clears his front leg, gets down on a knee and slogs it well over long-on
Spins away on a length on middle and off, clipped to deep midwicket
Quicker length ball, googly, punched to deep cover

Hops and slaps it away for four now. Short again and angling away, Samson is deep in his crease. He hops and punches it well wide of backward point, Rashid from sweeper cover cannot get there. Gill wants the bowler to bowl full but he did otherwise

Heaved away and it goes the distance. Samson connects one after some time. Back of a length landing outside leg, 136.4kph, Samson is waiting for it in his crease. Goes back and never tries to keep it down, picks it up wonderfully
Outside off on a length, slapped to deep cover
Gets hold of it alright. Full toss on middle and leg, 139.2kph, he already had a stable base and heaves it through midwicket. Valiant effort in the deep by Sai Sudharsan
Inswinging yorker on middle and leg, he just about manages to dig it out
Goes back to the shortish ball and heaves it down to long-off. Hit him high on the blade and that saves him
another googly! This dips on a shortish length outside off, and ends on middle. Punched to long-off
on a good length on his pads, and nudged to deep midwicket
fullish and outside leg. Wide called, as Hetmyer looked to clip but missed
wow, sharp turn! On a shortish length on the stumps, but finishes on leg to cramp Samson for room. Eventually, it is pushed to long-on
full and dipping around sixth stump. Punched back on the bounce to Rashid
short in length around middle, and turning away. Punched to long-on
over long-on! Hetmyer gets his front leg out of the way at this full ball dipping on middle and leg, and sends it flaying
short of a length, and wide of off. Hacked hard to deep cover
shortish in length again, and just outside off. Swatted towards short midwicket
shorter side of a length on middle, and clipped to deep midwicket
short in length, and just outside off. Punched to long-on
on a good length on middle and off, and punched to long-on

nearly taken at point! Tewatia there threw himself to his left, but the ball just beat his left hand. It was a length ball outside off from Khejroliya, as Hetmyer ended up driving aerially and off the outside half of the bat
good length on leg, and turning away. Clipped to deep midwicket

Rashid is up in a celebreappeal for lbw, but it is turned down! He has a word with Buttler and Gill, and the latter reviews! There's clearly no bat involved, as Hetmyer looked to clip but missed. Ohh, ball tracking shows this shortish ball barely pitching a millimeter outside leg. So GT lose a review

good, low catch at deep midwicket by Sai Sudharsan! He judges the ball well, and takes it just off the ground. It was a googly from Rashid, who bowled it short on middle and off, and got it to turn in and finish on leg. But the ball didn't bounce all that much, I think, even as Jurel went for the pull. He ended up mistiming it, and Sai Sudharsan, placed a few steps inside the boundary, did well to grab it low
on the shorter side of a length on middle, with a hint of turn back in. Pulled to long-on
on a fullish length just outside off, and it straightens after pitching. Pushed down towards long-on
full and dipping on off, and driven to long-off
hooked to long leg! He gets on top of this bouncer just outside off, and rolls his wrists to keep this all along the ground, before finding the gap between a straightish fine leg and deep square leg
wide ball! Too short and high, as Khejroliya bangs it on leg. Jurel shaped to hook, but eventually let it go
shorter side of a length on middle, and clipped towards square leg. Jurel wants a run, but is sent back by Samson, even as the throw is wide of the stumps at the striker's end

tickled behind to Buttler! The keeper and the bowler go up, but wait... Parag reviews straightaway! It was a near yorker-length ball angling across towards Parag, as the ball landed just outside off. Parag opened the face of the bat to try and nudge it towards deep third, but the ball shaped away a bit, and replays show a spike as the ball passes the bat. Parag isn't pleased, though, and has a word with the umpire, who asks him to walk back. I wonder if Parag thought the spike was of the bat hitting the ground, but whatever, he's gone now
shorter side of a length, and this pitches on off. Slashed to deep cover
short of a length again, but this is on off. Guided towards deep third
bowls short on middle, and it is pulled to deep square leg
flicked wide of Buttler! Prasidh bowled full and just outside leg, and Parag went with the movement to clip this for four behind the wicket
leading edge to short third! Parag jammed his bat down at this yorker-length ball which swung in towards off
nearly bowled! Parag shapes to scoop, but the ball, which pitched fullish on middle and leg, almost clipped leg stump as he missed
short in length, and pitching on middle and off. But it finishes on leg, as Samson mistimes a pull towards short fine leg
on a short of a length on middle, and nudged towards square leg
a hat-trick of no-look sixes from Parag! Superb placement! He backs away early, and has a helicopter swing at this fullish ball pitching on the stumps but shaping into leg. Six over mid-on!

wow, that is too high for Buttler, who leaps to collect it! But it's not called wide, perhaps because the ball took off after passing Samson. Siraj bowled short outside off, as Samson swayed out of the way
swiped over midwicket! Siraj bowls a low full toss as the ball swings in and arrives on middle, and Samson, who is deep in the crease, has enough room to dispatch that ball
another very full delivery which swings in, but this lands on middle and off. Samson pushes it back to Siraj
an inswinging yorker on off from Siraj, and Samson digs it out to mid-off
shorter side of a length on middle and off, and clipped to midwicket
deep into the stands! Another no-look swing from Parag, but do watch out in the stands! On a length from Siraj, and outside off, as Parag liberally heaves that ball away over mid-on

punched to deep cover! Samson just stays deep in the crease, and gets on top of the bounce of this good-length ball just outside off. There isn't a lot of room to play that, but Samson plays it late enough, and finds the gap
driven off the outside half of the bat to deep third, as Parag plays forward at this fullish ball on off, but doesn't really come forward
another yorker a bit wide of off, but this time Samson drives it to deep-backward point
a swat-slash of a six! On the shorter side of a length, and around off, as Samson rides the bounce, and sends it sailing over deep cover for a magnificent shot
flayed away, and over short third! Fullish ball angling across and coming on in the corridor outside off, as Samson gets it off the outside edge to deep third

Buttler appeals for caught behind, but it's turned down! Gill ponders about a review, but doesn't go ahead eventually. It was a yorker from Arshad, who angled it across, and went wide of off. Samson went jamming with his bat, but missed. His bat definitely hit the ground there
he stands by opening his stance up a bit, and taps this length ball on off to mid-off. The ball had finished on middle, though

dropped... but outside the boundary line! A stylish, no-look six for Parag! I thought it was a right-handed Suresh Raina there, as Parag effortlessly clipped at this full ball arriving on middle. Six over deep midwicket!
chipped towards mid-off! Siraj bowls slightly fuller, and in the corridor outside off. Parag pushes forward aerially
short of a length around off, and pushed down towards midwicket

taken at deep third again! This time it is Khejroliya, who takes a step to his right before gobbling it down. Siraj had a slip added just before this ball, but went short instead of bowling full. It was banged around middle stump, and moved away to end close to off. Rana went ramping, but the ball hadn't bounced enough for that shot
well bowled! Siraj pitches it on the shorter side of a length on middle, and gets it to shape away and finish around sixth stump. Rana looked to jab but was beaten on the outside edge
lovely bowling! Arshad fires a yorker bang on middle stump at 138kph, and Samson, who shapes to lean into a probable flick, only manages to squeeze it back towards Arshad
short of a length on the stumps, and Samson has to leap on the crease to punch towards extra cover. Good, tight line from Arshad to the right-hander
extra bounce! Angled across, as he pitched it on the shorter side of a length just outside off. The ball shaped away, and beat Samson's outside edge, as he looked to punch
fullish delivery, and a little wide of off, as Rana drives wide of deep third without getting to the pitch of the ball. Rashid, at the boundary, ran and slid across to his left to cut it off
another one on a night of wides! Full and angling in, and pitching outside leg, as Rana looked to flick but missed

gone! Someone hear Ahmedabad roar! Rashid, at deep third, hardly had to move to his left to take this with a reverse cup. Arshad angled this into the left-hander, and went on a length and wide of off. The ball seemed to swing away, and Jaiswal went with the movement. He went driving aerially, playing far away from his body. But the timing wasn't all that bad - perhaps it was too good - as Jaiswal departed early
fumble at short midwicket, and Samson gets off the mark. Angled across, and on a length on off, as Samson pushed and the ball ricocheted off the fielder's hands to go wide of mid-on
clipped off his hips, and the ball dribbles towards deep square leg! Shorter side of a length on leg, and Jaiswal plays that late to beat the man at square leg to his left
beaten again! Siraj finding his lines back. On a good length on off, and again there is movement away from the pitch as Jaiswal looks to punch but sees the ball go past the outside edge
lovely comeback! Siraj goes full and angles it across for the ball to pitch around fifth stump, before it shapes away to beat Jaiswal on the outside edge after he attempted a lofty drive
now wide outside leg! Siraj bowls on a short of a length, and wide of leg. Jaiswal shapes to clip, but the ball is too wide there
another big wide, and Buttler collects the ball in front of first slip! I'm not sure if it's swinging a bit too much for Siraj, who goes fullish and wide of off, before Jaiswal leaves it alone
left alone! Wow! On a full length, and around fifth stump, and Jaiswal is happy to let it go
drilled to deep cover! Siraj goes fuller still, and the line is just outside off this time. Jaiswal hangs deep in the crease, and crunches the ball in the massive gap
ohh, beaten! He looks to loft this fuller ball angling across to arrive around sixth stump, but plays without any foot movement
very wide of off! Siraj angles this across, and goes on a length wide of off. Jaiswal lets it go, as the ball shapes away further
